Services FAQ

Frequently asked questions.

Clear information regarding our interior fit-out scope, gypsum works, and turnkey execution across Abu Dhabi.

What services does NASAQ specialize in?

NASAQ specializes in interior fit-out, villa fit-out, office fit-out, commercial fit-out, gypsum board works, false ceilings, interior partitions, interior finishing, and interior renovation.

Does NASAQ execute specialist commercial sectors and room remodelling?

Yes. In addition to turnkey villa and office fit-outs, NASAQ delivers specialist interior implementation for medical clinics, healthcare facilities, restaurants, cafes, salons, spas, and luxury residential rooms including bathroom remodelling, master bedrooms, and dining spaces, backed by dedicated drywall, ceiling, tiling, and Level-5 finishing trades across Abu Dhabi.

How does NASAQ ensure project quality and material compliance?

All works utilize ASTM C1396 compliant gypsum, moisture-resistant boards for wet areas, and heavy-gauge galvanized framing. Our on-site supervisors enforce strict Level-5 finishing protocols.

What is NASAQ's typical execution timeline?

Timelines depend on project scale and approvals. Room and ceiling upgrades typically take 1 to 2 weeks, while full villa or office fit-outs take 4 to 8 weeks with structured milestones.
